messages.text: I want to cancel my order and get a refund, it hasn't shipped yet. How long does that take?

Good news: unshipped orders can be cancelled for a full refund, shipping included. Once it's confirmed, the refund goes back to your original payment method the same business day and usually shows up in 3–5 business days.

I can't cancel it myself — I look things up and a team member completes the cancellation. To get it moving, send me your order number and the email address on the order, and I'll pull it up and check it's still unshipped.
